name: Andrews & Eells

locations.basis: Placeable against the committed town. The landmark is the committed structure tremont_house_1.
locations.limit_reason: The register places this house against tremont_house_1 and the town holds no roof of its own for it (action: new_building), so the anchor is as far as the reading goes.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-10-29, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
